results.title: The Hindu Exclusive confirmed: Hardik Pandya moves to Punjab Kings, Arshdeep to MI
results.content: It’s official! In the biggest IPL trade in the league’s history, Hardik Pandya is moving to the Punjab Kings, while Arshdeep Singh is joining the Mumbai Indians. Following exclusive reports by The Hindu and Sportstar, the IPL has officially confirmed this blockbuster player swap. In this video, The Hindu’s Amol Karhadkar breaks down the complex trade procedure, why it took weeks to finalise, how Hardik Pandya fits into Punjab alongside Shreyas Iyer and Ricky Ponty, what Arshdeep brings to Mumbai’s bowling attack alongside Jasprit Bumrah, and what to expect before the November 17 trading window deadline ahead of the IPL 2026 auction in Goa.
